title: DID: rfind(' ') in DID URL parsing is ambiguous for fragment DID URLs
description: crates/reader/src/post/did_passthrough.rs (or did_verify.rs): splitting a DID URL on the last space using rfind(' ') to separate the DID from the signature is fragile. A DID URL that contains a fragment or query component after a space would be split incorrectly. Fix: define a clear wire format for X-Stoa-DID-Sig header values (e.g., DID-URL SP BASE64-SIG with the sig always being the last whitespace-delimited token) and document it; or use a structured format that does not rely on positional space splitting.
